WITH FacilityMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        e.facid AS facility_id,
        tb.medadh AS treatment_adherence_rate,
        tb.crisisint AS crisis_intervention_frequency,
        e.missappt AS missed_appointment_rate,
        -- Calculate PSM as 1 - (crisis intervention frequency + missed appointment rate)
        1 - (tb.crisisint + e.missappt) AS psm
    FROM 
        encounters e
    JOIN 
        treatmentbasics tb ON e.enckey = tb.encref
),
PerformanceQuadrants AS (
    SELECT 
        facility_id,
        treatment_adherence_rate,
        psm,
        -- Categorize facilities into performance quadrants
        CASE
            WHEN treatment_adherence_rate = 'High' AND psm > 0.5 THEN 'Q1'
            WHEN treatment_adherence_rate = 'Medium' AND psm > 0.3 THEN 'Q2'
            WHEN treatment_adherence_rate = 'Low' AND psm > 0.1 THEN 'Q3'
            ELSE 'Q4'
        END AS performance_quadrant
    FROM 
        FacilityMetrics
)
SELECT 
    facility_id,
    treatment_adherence_rate,
    psm AS stability_score,
    performance_quadrant
FROM 
    PerformanceQuadrants
ORDER BY 
    performance_quadrant DESC;

WITH facility_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        f.fackey AS facility_id,
        (
            -- Calculate PFIS: Average of functional impairment scores
            AVG(
                CASE 
                    WHEN a.funcimp = 'Severe' THEN 3
                    WHEN a.funcimp = 'Moderate' THEN 2
                    WHEN a.funcimp = 'Mild' THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
        ) AS pfis,
        (
            -- Calculate FRAI: Average of resource adequacy scores
            AVG(
                CASE 
                    WHEN f.support_and_resources->>'community_resources' = 'Comprehensive' THEN 3
                    WHEN f.support_and_resources->>'community_resources' = 'Adequate' THEN 2
                    WHEN f.support_and_resources->>'community_resources' = 'Limited' THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
        ) AS frai
    FROM 
        facilities f
    JOIN 
        clinicians c ON f.fackey = c.facconnect
    JOIN 
        patients p ON c.clinkey = p.clinleadref
    JOIN 
        assessmentbasics ab ON p.patkey = ab.patownerref
    JOIN 
        assessmentsocialanddiagnosis a ON ab.abkey = a.asdkey
    GROUP BY 
        f.fackey
),
rdd_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        facility_id,
        ROUND(pfis - frai, 2) AS rdd
    FROM 
        facility_metrics
)
SELECT 
    facility_id, rdd
FROM 
    rdd_scores
ORDER BY 
    rdd DESC
LIMIT 10;

4fb823c22e3685ee8b8591f1d7384eda4e2147a8.sql:
WITH facility_resources AS (
    SELECT fackey
    FROM facilities
    WHERE (
        support_and_resources->>'community_resources')::TEXT IN ('Adequate', 'Comprehensive')
),
clinician_stability_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        c.clinkey AS clinician_id,
        e.facid AS facility_id,
        ROUND(1 / (1 + AVG(tb.crisisint) + AVG(e.missappt))) AS stability_score,
        c.facconnect AS fackey
    FROM 
        clinicians c
    JOIN 
        encounters e ON c.clinkey = e.clinid
    JOIN 
        treatmentbasics tb ON e.enckey = tb.encref
    JOIN 
        facility_resources fr ON c.facconnect = fr.fackey
    GROUP BY 
        c.clinkey, e.facid, c.facconnect
),
ranked_clinicians AS (
    SELECT 
        clinician_id,
        facility_id,
        stability_score,
        fackey,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fackey ORDER BY stability_score DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        clinician_stability_scores
)
SELECT 
    clinician_id,
    facility_id,
    stability_score,
    rank
FROM 
    ranked_clinicians
ORDER BY 
    facility_id, rank;

06a6d8a440f2c64ce6b2ea488658404dba2c0c4d.sql:
WITH frai_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        fackey, 
        CASE 
            WHEN support_and_resources->>'community_resources' = 'Comprehensive' THEN 3
            WHEN support_and_resources->>'community_resources' = 'Adequate' THEN 2
            WHEN support_and_resources->>'community_resources' = 'Limited' THEN 1
        END AS resource_score
    FROM facilities
),
facility_frai AS (
    SELECT 
        fackey, 
        AVG(resource_score) AS frai
    FROM frai_scores
    GROUP BY fackey
),
suicide_risk_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        facid, 
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe')) AS high_risk_count, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_assessments
    FROM encounters AS e
    JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk AS asr ON e.abref = asr.asrkey
    GROUP BY facid
),
high_risk_facilities AS (
    SELECT 
        sr.facid, 
        high_risk_count, 
        total_assessments, 
        (high_risk_count::DECIMAL / total_assessments) * 100 AS high_risk_prevalence
    FROM suicide_risk_counts sr
    WHERE (high_risk_count::DECIMAL / total_assessments) * 100 > 20
),
funcimp_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        e.facid, 
        CASE 
            WHEN asd.funcimp = 'Severe' THEN 3
            WHEN asd.funcimp = 'Moderate' THEN 2
            WHEN asd.funcimp = 'Mild' THEN 1
        END AS funcimp_score
    FROM encounters AS e
    JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis AS asd ON e.abref = asd.asdkey
),
facility_pfis AS (
    SELECT 
        facid, 
        AVG(funcimp_score) AS pfis
    FROM funcimp_scores
    GROUP BY facid
),
rdd_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        f.facid, 
        pf.pfis, 
        ff.frai, 
        (pf.pfis - ff.frai) AS rdd
    FROM high_risk_facilities f
    JOIN facility_pfis pf ON f.facid = pf.facid
    JOIN facility_frai ff ON f.facid = ff.fackey
)
SELECT 
    rs.facid AS facility_id, 
    rs.pfis, 
    rs.frai, 
    rs.rdd
FROM rdd_scores rs
ORDER BY rs.rdd DESC
LIMIT 100;

WITH sse_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        a.abkey, 
        (
            SUM(
                CASE 
                    WHEN asd.socsup = 'Strong' THEN 3 
                    WHEN asd.socsup = 'Moderate' THEN 2 
                    WHEN asd.socsup = 'Limited' THEN 1 
                    ELSE 0 
                END + 
                CASE 
                    WHEN asd.relqual = 'Good' THEN 3 
                    WHEN asd.relqual = 'Fair' THEN 2 
                    WHEN asd.relqual = 'Poor' THEN 1 
                    WHEN asd.relqual = 'Conflicted' THEN 0 
                    ELSE 0 
                END
            )
        ) / COUNT(*) AS sse_score
    FROM 
        assessmentsocialanddiagnosis AS asd
    JOIN 
        assessmentbasics AS a ON asd.asdkey = a.abkey
    GROUP BY 
        a.abkey
),
patient_missed_appointments AS (
    SELECT 
        e.patref, 
        AVG(e.missappt) AS avg_missed_appointments
    FROM 
        encounters AS e
    GROUP BY 
        e.patref
),
latest_sse_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        a.patownerref, 
        s.sse_score, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.patownerref ORDER BY a.abkey DESC) AS row_num
    FROM 
        assessmentbasics AS a
    JOIN 
        sse_scores AS s ON a.abkey = s.abkey
)
SELECT 
    p.patkey, 
    pma.avg_missed_appointments, 
    lss.sse_score
FROM 
    patients AS p
JOIN 
    patient_missed_appointments AS pma ON p.patkey = pma.patref
JOIN 
    latest_sse_scores AS lss ON p.patkey = lss.patownerref
WHERE 
    lss.row_num = 1
AND 
    lss.sse_score < 3
ORDER BY 
    p.patkey;

9a44e09ae88ae8c94bbb2db63cc1e09d40cbab0f.sql:
WITH therapy_changes AS (
    SELECT
        (
            therapy_details ->> 'changes'::TEXT
        )::VARCHAR AS change_type,
        (
            therapy_details ->> 'engagement'::TEXT
        )::VARCHAR AS previous_engagement,
        LEAD(
            (
                therapy_details ->> 'engagement'::TEXT
            )
        ) OVER (
            ORDER BY txkey
        ) AS next_engagement
    FROM
        treatmentbasics
),
engagement_variations AS (
    SELECT
        change_type,
        previous_engagement,
        next_engagement,
        CASE
            WHEN previous_engagement = next_engagement THEN 0
            WHEN previous_engagement IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN next_engagement IS NULL THEN -1
            ELSE (
                (
                    SELECT engagement_order
                    FROM (
                        VALUES
                            ('Non-compliant', 1),
                            ('Low', 2),
                            ('Medium', 3),
                            ('High', 4)
                        ) AS t (engagement_level, engagement_order)
                    WHERE
                        t.engagement_level = next_engagement
                ) - (
                    SELECT engagement_order
                    FROM (
                        VALUES
                            ('Non-compliant', 1),
                            ('Low', 2),
                            ('Medium', 3),
                            ('High', 4)
                        ) AS t (engagement_level, engagement_order)
                    WHERE
                        t.engagement_level = previous_engagement
                )
            )
        END AS engagement_variation
    FROM
        therapy_changes
)
SELECT
    change_type,
    COUNT(*) AS total_occurrences,
    AVG(
        CAST(
            engagement_variation AS NUMERIC
        )
    ) AS average_engagement_variation
FROM
    engagement_variations
GROUP BY
    change_type
LIMIT 10;

80b8b52704c076a76ddf063134d2d92c5d0195ab.sql:
WITH treatment_adherence AS (
    SELECT 
        f.fackey AS facility_id,
        TO_JSONB(f.support_and_resources) AS support_resources,
        tx.medadh AS medication_adherence,
        txo.txadh AS treatment_adherence
    FROM 
        facilities f
    JOIN 
        clinicians c ON f.fackey = c.facconnect
    JOIN 
        patients p ON c.clinkey = p.clinleadref
    JOIN 
        encounters e ON p.patkey = e.patref
    JOIN 
        treatmentbasics tx ON e.enckey = tx.encref
    JOIN 
        treatmentoutcomes txo ON tx.txkey = txo.txref
),
resource_adequacy AS (
    SELECT 
        facility_id,
        (
            support_resources->>'community_resources' = 'Adequate'
        )::INT AS resource_adequacy_score
    FROM 
        treatment_adherence
),
treatment_adherence_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        facility_id,
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN medication_adherence = 'High' THEN 1
                WHEN medication_adherence = 'Medium' THEN 0.5
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS med_adh_rate,
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN treatment_adherence = 'High' THEN 1
                WHEN treatment_adherence = 'Medium' THEN 0.5
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS treat_adh_rate
    FROM 
        treatment_adherence
    GROUP BY 
        facility_id
),
overall_support_index AS (
    SELECT 
        ra.facility_id,
        AVG(
            resource_adequacy_score + med_adh_rate + treat_adh_rate
        ) AS osi
    FROM 
        resource_adequacy ra
    JOIN 
        treatment_adherence_rate tar ON ra.facility_id = tar.facility_id
    GROUP BY 
        ra.facility_id
)
SELECT 
    CORR(
        osi.osi, 
        tar.treat_adh_rate
    ) AS correlation_coefficient
FROM 
    overall_support_index osi
JOIN 
    treatment_adherence_rate tar ON osi.facility_id = tar.facility_id;
